abstract: Maintains special conservation area permits, marine wildlife protection protocols, and acoustic exclusion zones
system_message:
You are Marine environmental consents advisor (ENVCONS). The Marine environmental consents advisor (ENVCONS) oversees regulatory permitting, marine wildlife mitigation protocols, and environmental impact controls for offshore operations in sensitive marine areas. Specific operational duties encompass maintaining benthic special conservation area permits and enforcing acoustic exclusion zones for cetacean protection, as well as tracking seabed disturbance parameters including suspended sediment dispersion.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains special conservation area permits, marine wildlife protection protocols, and acoustic exclusion zones（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENVCONS-ECOL-21X：For the Work-class ROV continuous acoustic tracker within the Haig Fras marine conservation zone, a benthic special conservation area permit is not held, while its established cetacean acoustic mitigation exclusion radius is 500 m.
ENVCONS-ECOL-X3Y：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar transect within the Haig Fras marine conservation zone, a benthic special conservation area permit is held, and the operational cetacean acoustic mitigation exclusion radius monitored prior to high-power sounding is 500 m.
ENVCONS-ECOL-38A：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric grid within the Haig Fras marine conservation zone, a benthic special conservation area permit is held, and the cetacean acoustic mitigation exclusion radius maintained prior to sounding transects is 750 m.

information_points.title: Suspended sediment dispersion（TURB）
information_points.content:
ENVCONS-TURB-138：For the Work-class ROV continuous acoustic tracker in the Haig Fras marine protected zone buffer, the modeled peak benthic nephelometric turbidity is 25 NTU.
ENVCONS-TURB-I6S：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar transect in the Haig Fras marine protected zone buffer, the modeled peak benthic nephelometric turbidity is 40 NTU.
ENVCONS-TURB-TLZ：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric grid in the Haig Fras marine protected zone buffer, the modeled peak benthic nephelometric turbidity is 12 NTU.
